Project Notes

项目说明

Tension Fold · 折叠与张力

六套造型以灰阶为主线。肩部和前身的斜向折线延伸至腰胯，裙摆的长短变化让同一条斜线在不同造型中形成呼应。款式图拆开展示外套、内搭和半裙的正背面。

Across six tonal grey looks, diagonal folds travel from the shoulder towards the hip. Uneven hemlines repeat that direction. Front and back flats isolate the jacket, inner top and skirt.

Asymmetric Tailoring · 错位西装

千鸟格与深灰色块在前身交错，西装驳领与内搭的斜摆形成两条不同长度的对角线。裤脚的浅色曲线呼应裙身拼接，连接上下装的视觉节奏。

Houndstooth meets charcoal across the jacket front. The lapel and angled dress hem draw diagonals at different lengths, while pale curved panels link the dress to the trouser hems.

About Me

个人介绍

李德胜 / Desheng Li

我在釜山大学学习服装设计，研究生成式 AI、CLO3D 与 VR 在服装设计过程中的应用。这本作品集把完整造型与单品款式图并置，方便对照轮廓与结构。

I study fashion design at Pusan National University. My research explores generative AI, CLO3D and virtual reality in the fashion design process. This portfolio pairs styled looks with technical flats to show how each silhouette is constructed.
